record.title: GGEN Ecosystem OCEL current
record.body: CELL1 manufactured a 50-commit frontier/integrity sensor family in the canonical ggen-ecosystem-ocel-pack. Exact marketplace base 8f881772256de00cbfbc1e410324f6c4a1ec7134; exact head d99cd4e1224dcfcbf74037c023c7ed2cd60f42cc; draft PR #332. This run did not execute a new deterministic OCEL projection, so it does not claim a new OCEL artifact/digest or promote O/Q/M for the new head. The previously observed canonical digest sha256:0b059d5edbffabba09dd7f17196d9c8686775ee351acf5e16cc81e5a95f7df51 remains historical input evidence, not a digest manufactured by CELL1. Fresh ForcedTop25 exact-head census was completed and exposed multiple stale remembered heads. Memory-loop PRE was incomplete because only canonical OCEL and ForcedTop25 reads received ALIVE receipts before manufacture; therefore the run-level memory-loop standing is BUILD_BROKEN[PRE_READ_SET_INCOMPLETE] while the Git manufacturing work is independently PARTIAL_ALIVE pending exact-head qualification.
